title: Community rumor control board
summary: A low-tech method for separating confirmed facts, pending reports, rumors, and harmful claims during a village, building, camp, or family disruption.
content: Core sequence: 1) Create four columns: confirmed, checking, rumor, and action taken. 2) Write the source, time, exact words, and who is checking before repeating a report. 3) Move a claim only when a named person confirms it through an official channel, direct observation, or documented call. 4) Remove private names from public notices unless consent or immediate life safety requires disclosure.
